sessionStart.bash: c=$(tmux show -gv @agent_signal_command 2>/dev/null) && [ -n "$c" ] && AGENT_KIND=copilot "$c" set idle; exit 0

userPromptSubmitted.bash: c=$(tmux show -gv @agent_signal_command 2>/dev/null) && [ -n "$c" ] && AGENT_KIND=copilot "$c" set working; exit 0

postToolUse.bash: c=$(tmux show -gv @agent_signal_command 2>/dev/null) && [ -n "$c" ] && AGENT_KIND=copilot "$c" set working; exit 0

postToolUseFailure.bash: c=$(tmux show -gv @agent_signal_command 2>/dev/null) && [ -n "$c" ] && AGENT_KIND=copilot "$c" set working; exit 0

permissionRequest.bash: c=$(tmux show -gv @agent_signal_command 2>/dev/null) && [ -n "$c" ] && AGENT_KIND=copilot "$c" set blocked; exit 0

agentStop.bash: c=$(tmux show -gv @agent_signal_command 2>/dev/null) && [ -n "$c" ] && AGENT_KIND=copilot "$c" set done; exit 0
